Compliance policies evaluate device posture. Access enforcement requires a separately assigned Conditional Access policy that requires a compliant device; creating a compliance policy alone does not block access. For enterprise environments, iOS compliance should be designed with Conditional Access, device ownership, user experience and exception handling. The objective is to protect Microsoft 365 access without creating unnecessary mobile support friction.

Intune iOS Compliance Policy는 iPhone과 iPad가 회사 리소스에 접근하기 전에 최소 보안 조건을 만족하는지 확인하는 정책입니다. 암호·OS 버전·탈옥 여부를 평가하고, 규정 준수 디바이스를 요구하는 Conditional Access 정책으로 접근을 제어합니다. iOS/iPadOS 암호를 설정하면 암호화가 시작됩니다. 위협 수준 평가는 별도 MTD 또는 Defender 연동을 구성한 환경에만 추가합니다.
Passcode required Minimum OS version Jailbreak detection Encryption resulting from the device passcode requirement Optional threat evaluation after the selected MTD/Defender integration is configured

The following is a pilot design example, not a universal Microsoft security baseline. Use the actual iOS/iPadOS compliance setting names from the official settings reference. Setting or outcome Pilot choice and prerequisite Require a password to unlock mobile devices Require; choose password complexity and grace periods for the target population Passcode-driven encryption iOS/iPadOS starts encryption when a passcode is set; there is no separate Encryption = Required switch in this compliance settings list Jailbroken devices Block after testing detection and remediation on supported devices Minimum OS version Set an explicit supported version approved by the organization; recheck Intune support and app requirements Require the device to be at or under the Device Threat Level Only with a configured mobile threat defense service; choose Secured/Low/Medium/High after testing signal delivery and remediation Require the device to be at or under the machine risk score Separate Microsoft Defender for Endpoint risk evaluation; requires the Defender–Intune integration and applicable entitlement

Device Threat Level is supplied by the configured mobile threat defense (MTD) service. Machine risk score is supplied by Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. They are distinct settings; do not treat them as interchangeable signals or require both without an intentional design. Microsoft's example iOS/iPadOS configurations explicitly identify the MTD dependency. Before requiring either signal, confirm the product subscription, Intune connector configuration, platform support, security app deployment/onboarding, policy assignment and end-to-end risk reporting. Validate a risk change, the resulting compliance state, Conditional Access decision and recovery on pilot devices. See MTD integration and Defender–Intune integration. If no threat service is integrated, leave its dependent compliance setting Not configured while using the approved passcode/OS/jailbreak controls. This means that threat signal is not evaluated; it is not evidence of a low-risk device. Record the coverage gap and obtain the organization's security decision before broad enforcement.

macOS endpoints require a different device control model compared to Windows. Defender for Endpoint and Intune can provide USB governance and removable media restrictions. The design should start with audit mode, approved device requirements and user exception handling before enforcement. macOS controls must be tested carefully because user productivity, creative workflows and device ownership models vary widely.
macOS에서 USB 저장장치의 사용을 제한할 때 확인할 Defender for Endpoint와 Intune 설정을 정리했습니다. 사용 기록을 먼저 수집하고 승인 장치 목록, 읽기 전용과 차단 정책을 시험합니다. macOS와 Defender 버전별 지원 범위는 본문에 연결된 공식 자료에서 확인하세요.

Organizations often need to block unauthorized USB storage devices while allowing approved corporate USB devices. Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Defender Device Control can implement granular USB access policies. The strongest design starts with audit evidence, approved device inventory and exception governance before enforcement. This reduces business disruption while still improving data leakage control.

Microsoft 365 Apps의 다른 이름으로 저장 화면에서 로컬 저장소를 제외하고 OneDrive·SharePoint 같은 클라우드 위치만 제공하도록 구성하고 검증합니다. 배포 방법은 Active Directory 그룹 정책과 Microsoft 365 Apps 관리 센터의 Cloud Policy 두 가지입니다.
documents.s: M365 Apps 로컬 저장소 제한 및 클라우드 저장 강제

documents.t: Cloud Policy 공식 문서는 사용자 기반 정책 배포와 GPO 대비 우선순위를 설명합니다. 배포 전 대상 Office 빌드의 ADMX 또는 Cloud Policy 카탈로그에서 아래 정책과 레지스트리 값의 지원 여부를 확인하세요. GPO와 Cloud Policy의 일반적인 우선순위만으로 개별 설정의 지원 여부를 판단할 수는 없습니다. Microsoft 365 Apps 엔터프라이즈 구독 최신 Office ADMX/ADML 템플릿을 사용하는 Active Directory 환경 또는 Microsoft 365 Apps 관리 센터 Windows와 Office의 실제 버전을 기록하고 시험용 사용자에게 먼저 적용합니다. 저장 화면과 기존 파일 편집·저장 동작을 각각 확인하세요. 동일한 정책이 AD GPO와 Cloud Policy에 모두 구성되면 Cloud Policy가 우선 적용됩니다.

최신 Office Administrative Template을 중앙 저장소의 PolicyDefinitions에 반영한 다음 사용자 구성에서 클라우드가 아닌 위치에서 저장 제한 정책을 찾아 사용으로 설정합니다. 클라이언트에 정책이 적용되면 다음 레지스트리 값을 확인할 수 있습니다. HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Common\FileIO enablecloudonlysaveasmode = 1 (DWORD) 필요하면 정책을 갱신한 뒤 Office 앱을 다시 시작합니다. gpupdate /force Word, Excel 또는 PowerPoint에서 다른 이름으로 저장을 열었을 때 로컬 디스크가 제외되고 클라우드 저장소만 표시되는지 확인합니다.

Microsoft 365 Apps 관리 센터에 접속합니다. 사용자 지정 > 정책 관리 > 만들기로 이동합니다. 전체 사용자 대신 파일럿 보안 그룹을 먼저 할당합니다. 정책 구성에서 클라우드가 아닌 위치에서 저장 제한을 검색합니다. 설정을 사용으로 구성하고 배포합니다. Cloud Policy를 수신한 클라이언트에서는 다음 위치를 확인합니다. HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Cloud\Office\16.0\Common\FileIO enablecloudonlysaveasmode = 1 (DWORD) Cloud Policy와 AD GPO가 동시에 존재할 때에는 Cloud 경로의 정책이 우선합니다. Office 앱 로그인 계정을 변경하는 시나리오에서도 AD 사용자 정책 대상이라면 GPO에 의한 클라우드 저장 강제 상태가 유지되는지 함께 확인합니다.

정책 대상 사용자 또는 그룹이 정확한지 확인 정책 레지스트리 enablecloudonlysaveasmode=1 확인 Office 앱 재시작 후 Save As 화면 확인 로컬 디스크, 바탕 화면, 문서 폴더가 저장 대상으로 제공되지 않는지 확인 OneDrive 및 SharePoint 위치가 정상적으로 표시되는지 확인 오프라인, 동기화 장애, 클라우드 로그인 만료 시 사용자 경험 확인 Cloud Policy와 GPO를 함께 사용할 경우 우선순위 확인

이 설정은 Microsoft 365 Apps의 저장 UI를 클라우드 중심으로 제한하는 정책입니다. 운영체제 전체의 파일 쓰기, 다른 애플리케이션의 저장, 복사·붙여넣기, 스크린샷 또는 이미 존재하는 로컬 파일까지 모두 차단하는 통제는 아닙니다. 더 강한 통제가 필요하면 Endpoint DLP, AppLocker/WDAC, 디바이스 규정 준수 및 조건부 액세스를 함께 설계해야 합니다.

documents.t: Atomic Red Team provides safe adversary simulation tests used to validate Microsoft Defender detection and response capabilities. It allows organizations to verify detection coverage before real incidents occur.

Atomic testing should be scoped and approved before execution. Do not run broad test sets against production endpoints without a change window, rollback owner and SOC notification. Select a small number of techniques that match the control you want to validate, then document expected telemetry before running the test. Recommended controls: use dedicated test endpoints or pilot security groups where possible notify SOC analysts before execution so validation traffic is not mistaken for a real incident record the exact Atomic Red Team test ID, command, timestamp and target device avoid destructive techniques unless there is an approved lab environment compare Microsoft Defender timeline, incident queue and alert evidence after each test

The strongest outcome is not simply that an alert was generated. A good validation report should explain whether the alert was timely, mapped to the expected MITRE technique, enriched with useful device context and routed to the right response team. If no alert is generated, capture whether the gap is due to policy, telemetry, exclusion, licensing, platform support or test execution.

documents.t: Linux onboarding should validate distribution support, connectivity, package deployment, sensor health and Defender portal visibility before operational handover.
documents.s: Extend Defender visibility to Linux servers and workloads

documents.t: This guide describes Linux onboarding procedures for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. Linux onboarding enables endpoint visibility, threat detection and vulnerability management for Linux servers and workloads.

Support depends on the distribution, exact version, architecture and Defender build, not the distribution name alone. Use the current Linux requirements matrix and release notes. Record /etc/os-release, kernel/architecture and installed mdatp version in deployment evidence. Do not infer support for an end-of-life CentOS or other release from a generic “Yes” row.

Required: Python Installed Internet Connectivity Root Access Supported Linux Version Before onboarding, confirm whether the server is internet-connected, proxy-routed or isolated. Linux onboarding often fails because package repository access, SSL inspection, proxy authentication or outbound firewall rules were not reviewed before installation. Treat these checks as part of the deployment readiness review, not as post-install troubleshooting.

Linux onboarding architectureServer signal to Defender portal 01Linux serverSupported Linux workload is selected for Defender for Endpoint onboarding. 02Prerequisite checkConfirm distribution, package manager, Python, connectivity and proxy requirements. 03Defender agentInstall, onboard and validate sensor health and telemetry flow. 04Defender portalConfirm device inventory, alerting, vulnerability data and operational ownership.

Use the official distribution-specific installation procedure. Repository configuration and package signing-key registration differ across Debian/Ubuntu, RHEL-family and SUSE; one generic command sequence is not portable. Before installing: Read cat /etc/os-release and uname -m, then match the exact supported distribution/version. Configure the official production repository for that distribution and version using the linked procedure. Register Microsoft's package-signing key in the format and keyring location prescribed for that package manager. Downloading or printing the key alone does not register trust. Refresh repository metadata, install mdatp with the matching package manager, and record the selected package version. Apply the tenant-specific onboarding package, then validate health and cloud connectivity. The following commands are read-only preflight checks, not a standalone installer: cat /etc/os-release uname -m command -v python3 For Debian/Ubuntu the final package-install command is sudo apt-get install mdatp, after repository/key configuration and metadata refresh. RHEL/SUSE use their respective package-manager instructions. Follow the official repository instructions instead of inventing a download URL or reusing a different distribution's configuration.
Check status. mdatp health Check Org ID. mdatp health --field org_id Enable real-time protection. mdatp config real-time-protection --value enabled

Use the following criteria before marking the onboarding as complete: the device appears in Microsoft Defender XDR with the expected hostname and operating system mdatp health reports healthy cloud connectivity, real-time protection and valid organization ID vulnerability management data is visible for the onboarded server alert routing to the SOC or operations team has been validated proxy and update paths are documented for future patching or incident response For production Linux servers, capture a validation screenshot or command output as handover evidence. This prevents later disputes about whether the endpoint was onboarded, merely installed or fully operational.
Enable RTP Enable Vulnerability Management Monitor Health Status Integrate with SIEM Enable Alerting

documents.t: This guide describes the onboarding process for macOS devices into Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE). The objective is to provide centralized endpoint visibility, threat detection, vulnerability management and incident response capabilities for macOS devices.
Organizations commonly require: Corporate MacBook management Security monitoring Threat detection Device inventory Vulnerability management Zero Trust compliance

Issue Business Impact unmanaged Mac devices weak visibility for executives, developers and creative teams using macOS no unified endpoint signal Defender XDR incidents may miss macOS context inconsistent security baseline antivirus, EDR, network protection and device control may vary by device manual onboarding rollout quality depends on local administrator action missing validation evidence security and audit teams cannot prove coverage

Platform Supported macOS 13 Ventura No — outside the current Defender support range macOS 14 Sonoma or newer Check the current Defender support matrix and agent build Apple Silicon Yes Intel Mac Yes 확인 기준: 2026-10-25. Defender 릴리스·지원 기준은 macOS 14 이상을 안내하며 Ventura는 지원 범위 밖입니다. 이는 Defender 에이전트 기준입니다. Intune 관리 지원 OS는 Intune 지원 플랫폼에서 별도로 확인하세요. 두 제품을 함께 사용할 때에는 양쪽 조건을 모두 만족해야 하며, CPU 아키텍처 지원이 모든 OS 버전 지원을 뜻하지는 않습니다.

documents.s: Remove Defender coverage only with lifecycle evidence

documents.t: This guide explains how to remove Windows endpoints from Microsoft Defender for Endpoint using Intune deployment. Offboarding should be performed in a controlled manner to maintain security visibility and audit integrity. The process should be connected to device retirement, tenant migration, security tool transition and asset inventory updates. Uncontrolled offboarding can create unmanaged endpoint risk.
Windows 기기를 Defender for Endpoint에서 오프보딩할 때 확인할 승인·배포·검증 절차입니다. 오프보딩은 앱 제거와 다릅니다. 기기 상태와 마지막 통신, 대체 보호 수단을 확인하고 포털에 남는 기록은 보존 기간과 구분해 판단하세요.
Device Retirement Device Replacement Lab Environment Cleanup Tenant Migration Security Tool Transition

Windows offboarding architectureControlled removal from Defender scope 01Approval triggerDevice retirement, tenant migration, lab cleanup or security tool transition is approved. 02Intune assignmentDeploy offboarding package only to controlled target groups. 03Windows deviceDevice processes offboarding package and sensor state changes are monitored. 04Audit recordUpdate inventory, evidence, exception register and post-offboarding risk status.

Offboarding workflowPackage to evidence 01PackageGenerate Defender offboarding package and document expiry and scope. 02DeployAssign through Intune to selected devices using a staged rollout group. 03ValidateConfirm sensor state, portal inventory, device retirement and replacement protection. 04RecordStore audit evidence and update asset, support and security operations records.

Offboarding and uninstalling are different operations. Microsoft documents that status changes to inactive after seven days; historical data remains until its retention period expires, and the device profile can remain in inventory for up to 180 days. A remaining inventory entry is therefore not, by itself, an offboarding failure. See Offboard devices. Confirm the offboarding package validity, local state, last-seen behavior and replacement protection before closing the change. Verify: New detection, vulnerability and security data stop arriving after successful offboarding Offboarding state confirmed; do not treat this as uninstalling Windows Defender components Review the last-seen timestamp and lifecycle record; the inventory entry need not disappear immediately

documents.s: Turn public expertise into original consulting guidance

documents.t: This page organizes public Microsoft MVP and community knowledge sources into a practical research map for enterprise Microsoft 365, Copilot, Security, Purview and Azure architecture work. The goal is not to copy external articles. The goal is to monitor respected community patterns, translate them into consulting-ready checklists, and connect them with Microsoft official documentation and real delivery experience. Research operating loopPublic source to original guidance 01Monitor public sourcesFollow MVP blogs, community posts, product blogs and official Microsoft documentation. 02Extract field signalsCapture recurring patterns, caveats, support boundaries and operational risks. 03Validate against deliveryCompare findings with customer scenarios, project artifacts and Microsoft official behavior. 04Publish original guidanceConvert insight into checklists, runbooks, architecture notes and update backlog items.
Microsoft MVP와 커뮤니티 전문가의 공개 블로그·기술 자료를 주제별로 모았습니다. 커뮤니티 글은 운영 경험을 참고하는 데 사용하고, 현재 지원 조건과 설정 방법은 Microsoft 공식 문서와 다시 확인하세요.

Use public sources only. Do not reproduce full articles or proprietary diagrams. Convert community insight into original consulting guidance. Prefer official Microsoft documentation for product behavior and support boundaries. Use MVP/community blogs to identify field-tested patterns, caveats and operational lessons. Attribute external sources when a page is directly referenced.

이 문서는 비관리 디바이스에서 SharePoint Online 또는 OneDrive에 접근할 때 데스크톱 앱 접속과 로컬 다운로드·인쇄·동기화를 차단하고, 브라우저에서만 읽기 전용으로 열람하도록 구성하는 방법을 설명합니다. 여기서는 브라우저와 앱을 함께 테스트하지만 실제 적용 범위는 Microsoft Entra 조건부 액세스의 사용자, 디바이스 상태, 위치, 클라이언트 앱 조건으로 유연하게 설계할 수 있습니다.
documents.s: SharePoint·OneDrive Limited Access로 웹 전용 읽기 액세스 구현

documents.t: 경로 기대 동작 브라우저 파일 미리보기 및 읽기 허용 브라우저 편집 ReadOnlyForUnmanagedDevices 또는 AllowEditing 설정에 따라 차단 다운로드·인쇄·동기화 차단 Office 데스크톱 앱 액세스 거부

SharePoint Online Management Shell에서 개인 사이트가 포함된 사이트 목록과 대상 OneDrive URL을 확인합니다. Get-SPOSite -IncludePersonalSite $true 대상 사이트에 Limited Access 모드를 적용합니다. Set-SPOSite -Identity 'https://<tenant>-my.sharepoint.com/personal/<user>' ` -ConditionalAccessPolicy AllowLimitedAccess 적용 결과는 다음 명령으로 확인합니다. Get-SPOSite -Identity 'https://<tenant>-my.sharepoint.com/personal/<user>' | Select-Object Url, ConditionalAccessPolicy ConditionalAccessPolicy 값이 AllowLimitedAccess인지 확인합니다.

기본 Limited Access는 다운로드와 인쇄를 제한합니다. 다음 옵션을 조합하면 브라우저 읽기 전용 범위와 미리보기 가능한 파일 형식을 더 엄격하게 제어할 수 있습니다. 매개 변수 권장 값 효과 AllowEditing $false 브라우저에서 Office 파일 편집 차단 ReadOnlyForUnmanagedDevices $true 정책 대상 디바이스에서 사이트 전체를 읽기 전용으로 제공 LimitedAccessFileType OfficeOnlineFilesOnly Office Online 파일만 브라우저 미리보기 허용 Set-SPOTenant -AllowEditing $false ` -ReadOnlyForUnmanagedDevices $true ` -LimitedAccessFileType OfficeOnlineFilesOnly

기능 OfficeOnlineFilesOnly WebPreviewableFiles OtherFiles Office 파일 웹 미리보기 ✅ ✅ ✅ PDF·이미지 미리보기 ❌ ✅ ✅ ZIP·EXE 등 비미리보기 파일 접근 ❌ ❌ ✅ Office 파일 다운로드 ❌ ❌ ❌ PDF·이미지 다운로드 ❌ ❌ ❌ ZIP·EXE 다운로드 ❌ ❌ ✅ Office 데스크톱 앱 접근 ❌ ❌ ❌ 상대적 보안 수준 높음 중간 낮음 OtherFiles는 미리보기가 불가능한 파일의 다운로드를 허용하므로 웹 전용 Read Only 목표에는 적합하지 않습니다.

Microsoft Entra 관리 센터에서 다음과 같이 파일럿 정책을 만듭니다. 대상 사용자는 우선 테스트 계정 또는 파일럿 그룹으로 제한합니다. 대상 리소스는 Office 365 SharePoint Online을 선택합니다. 조건에서 적용할 디바이스 상태, 위치 또는 클라이언트 앱을 지정합니다. 세션 제어에서 앱 적용 제한(Use app enforced restrictions) 을 선택합니다. 보고 전용 모드로 영향도를 확인한 다음 정책을 사용 상태로 전환합니다. 정책 전파에는 수 분이 걸릴 수 있습니다.

OneDrive 웹에 접속하면 다운로드·인쇄·동기화가 제한된다는 안내가 표시되는지 확인합니다. Office 파일의 파일 메뉴에서 로컬 저장 및 다운로드 항목이 제거되었는지 확인합니다. 파일이 편집 모드가 아닌 읽기 전용으로 열리는지 확인합니다. Office 데스크톱 앱에서 같은 파일을 열 때 액세스가 거부되는지 확인합니다. PDF, 이미지, ZIP 등 파일 형식별 동작이 선택한 LimitedAccessFileType과 일치하는지 확인합니다.
테넌트 수준 설정은 여러 사이트에 영향을 줄 수 있으므로 변경 전 현재 값을 기록하고 파일럿으로 검증합니다. 조건부 액세스의 긴급 액세스 계정은 정책 대상에서 제외합니다. 브라우저 읽기 전용은 화면 캡처나 수기 전재까지 방지하는 완전한 데이터 유출 통제가 아닙니다. 민감 데이터에는 Purview DLP, 민감도 레이블, 엔드포인트 통제를 함께 검토합니다.

documents.s: Turn hidden Junk Email activity into visible security signals

documents.t: This guide describes how Power Automate can monitor Exchange Online Junk Email folders and generate automated notifications. The objective is to improve visibility of potentially malicious email activity and reduce missed security events.

Users often fail to review Junk Email folders. Important emails may be incorrectly classified. Organizations require: Junk email visibility Alert notification Security monitoring User awareness Reporting

Junk mail alert architectureExchange signal to team notification 01Exchange OnlineMonitor selected Junk Email folders or mailbox signals for messages requiring visibility. 02Power AutomateTrigger workflow, collect message metadata and apply filtering logic. 03Teams notificationNotify a security, help desk or operations channel with actionable context. 04Email summarySend summary or evidence record for follow-up, tuning and reporting.

Alert workflowDetect, enrich, notify 01New junk emailA message lands in scope for monitoring based on mailbox or folder criteria. 02Collect metadataCapture sender, subject, received time, recipient, classification and message indicators. 03Generate alertFormat relevant context for review without exposing unnecessary sensitive content. 04Notify and reportPost to Teams, send email summary and maintain visibility for tuning.

Use the Office 365 Outlook connector's When a new email arrives (V3) trigger, selecting the intended mailbox's Junk Email folder. Validate the connection account and use the appropriate shared-mailbox trigger when relevant. The connector reference documents permissions, limits and trigger behavior. This is a notification pattern, not a guaranteed security-event pipeline. A message moved between folders may not trigger as expected; test direct arrival, later moves, duplicates, protected messages and throttling. Quarantined mail is separate from a mailbox's Junk Email folder. Correlation with Defender/Sentinel/Purview is an additional design requiring its own data access and implementation. Do not copy message bodies or sensitive attachments into broad notification channels.

documents.s: Use Business Premium when productivity and baseline security must move together

documents.t: Microsoft 365 Business Premium is a strong option for small and mid-sized organizations that need productivity, identity protection, endpoint management and baseline security in one package. It is often suitable when the organization wants Microsoft 365, Intune, Defender for Business and Entra ID capabilities without moving immediately to enterprise E3, E5 or E7 licensing.

Microsoft 365 Business Premium에는 업무 앱과 메일·파일 공유, Entra ID P1, Intune, Defender for Business가 포함됩니다. Teams는 구매한 상품의 포함 여부를 확인하세요. 메일과 Office 외에 MFA, Conditional Access, 기기 관리와 엔드포인트 보호가 필요한 조직에서 검토할 수 있습니다. 포함 기능과 구매할 상품의 Teams 제공 여부는 별도로 확인하세요. 필요한 보안·관리·규정 준수 기능이 Business Premium에 포함되는지 확인하고 부족한 기능은 추가 구독과 비교하세요.
Modernize email and collaboration Manage Windows and mobile devices Establish MFA and Conditional Access Improve endpoint security Standardize cloud productivity for growing teams

Business Premium capability pathProductivity to security baseline 01Users and appsProvide Microsoft 365 Apps, Exchange, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive for daily work. 02Identity baselineApply Entra ID, MFA, Conditional Access and account protection policies. 03Device managementUse Intune for device compliance, configuration and mobile application management. 04Endpoint securityDefender for Business adds endpoint protection, alerts and security operations baseline.

Confirm user count and license eligibility. Enable MFA and identity baseline. Configure Intune enrollment and compliance policy. Deploy Microsoft 365 Apps. Enable Defender for Business. Review external sharing and data protection settings.

Microsoft documents a combined limit of 300 provisioned seats across Business Basic, Business Standard and Business Premium. Count all Business-family seats together; enterprise subscriptions are a separate option. Verify the purchased variant's Teams entitlement and any server add-ons in the Business Premium FAQ. 고급 규정 준수·보안 조사·통화 기능 등이 필요하면 E3·E5와 필요한 추가 기능을 비교합니다. 업무용 Copilot·Entra Suite·Agent 365까지 함께 필요하면 E7도 비교하세요.

Business Premium is usually a practical fit when the organization needs: Microsoft 365 productivity and collaboration as the main platform baseline identity security with MFA and Conditional Access Intune-based device enrollment, compliance policy and app protection endpoint protection through Defender for Business 실제로 운영할 수 있는 기기·계정·보안 관리 범위 a cost-conscious license path for a controlled Microsoft 365 rollout

인원수만으로 상위 플랜을 정하지 말고, Business Premium과 추가 구독으로 필요한 기능을 충족할 수 있는지 확인하세요. E7에는 E5의 기능과 Microsoft 365 Copilot·Microsoft Entra Suite·Microsoft Agent 365가 포함됩니다. Microsoft 공식 비교와 E3·E5·E7 비교에서 포함 기능과 비용 조건을 확인하세요. Requirement Why It Matters Advanced compliance Purview, retention, eDiscovery, DLP and audit requirements may exceed the Business Premium boundary. Enterprise security operations Defender XDR, advanced hunting and security operations integration may require E5-level capabilities. 고급 보호·업무용 Copilot·Entra Suite·Agent 365 E7 묶음과 Business Premium 또는 E5에 필요한 제품을 추가한 구성의 총비용을 비교합니다. Large-scale governance Large tenants often need more advanced policy, reporting, delegation and operational controls. Complex voice or meeting requirements Enterprise voice and advanced meeting scenarios may require additional licensing decisions. Regulated industry control evidence Finance, healthcare, public sector or manufacturing environments often require more formal evidence packs.

Enforce MFA for all users. Use Conditional Access templates carefully. Manage devices through Intune. Enable endpoint protection and security baselines. Review admin roles and emergency access accounts.

Question Recommended Review User count and license eligibility Confirm Microsoft licensing boundaries before designing the final bill of materials. Identity readiness Check MFA, admin roles, emergency access, guest access and Conditional Access requirements. Device management scope Confirm Windows, macOS, iOS, Android and BYOD policy expectations. Security baseline Decide which Microsoft security baseline, Defender configuration and alert ownership model will be used. Data protection Review external sharing, sensitivity, retention and DLP requirements before assuming Business Premium is enough. Operations model Assign ownership for user onboarding, device compliance, security alerts and policy exceptions.

In retail, manufacturing and professional service environments, Business Premium is often used as a pragmatic modernization step: replace fragmented email and endpoint tools, standardize Microsoft 365 collaboration, enable MFA, and introduce Intune/Defender controls without creating an enterprise-scale program on day one. The strongest results come when licensing, security baseline, device policy and operations handover are designed together.
Business Premium can deliver strong value when implemented as a full security and management platform. If it is used only for email and Office apps, much of the package value is left unused.

E3는 협업과 기본 관리, E5는 고급 보안·규정 준수, E7은 E5에 업무용 Copilot과 에이전트 관리를 함께 도입할 때 검토하는 구성입니다. E7에는 Microsoft 365 E5 + Microsoft 365 Copilot + Microsoft Entra Suite + Microsoft Agent 365가 포함됩니다. E5에 Copilot만 추가하는 경우와는 구성과 비용이 다릅니다. 필요한 기능과 사용할 사람을 정한 뒤 기존 구독·추가 기능과 비교하세요.

기준일은 2026년 10월 26일입니다. 아래는 Microsoft 365 기업용 플랜의 비교이며 Office 365 E3·E5와 구분합니다. Teams 포함·미포함 상품과 이용 지역, 계약 조건을 확인하세요. 기능 포함 여부는 Microsoft의 E3·E5·E7 비교, E7의 구성은 E7 제품 안내를 기준으로 정리했습니다. 라이선스를 구매한 뒤에도 사용자 할당과 정책 설정이 필요합니다.
협업, 기기 관리, 보안 조사, 자료 보호와 AI 사용 중 필요한 업무를 고릅니다. 현재 구독과 사용자별 서비스 플랜, 따로 구매한 보안·Copilot 기능을 확인합니다. E3·E5·E7과 필요한 추가 기능을 같은 요구사항으로 비교합니다. 실제 사용할 사용자 수, 구독료, 사용량 요금과 운영 담당자를 정합니다.

Microsoft Security Copilot과 일반 업무용 Microsoft 365 Copilot은 다른 제품입니다. Security Copilot의 적격 조건과 제공 범위를 별도로 확인하세요.
메일·문서·협업과 계정·기기 관리가 중심이고, 고급 보안 기능이 일부 사용자나 특정 업무에만 필요하다면 E3와 필요한 추가 기능을 비교합니다. Copilot 도입이나 Zero Trust 설계만으로 E5·E7 구매가 결정되지는 않습니다.
위험 기반 접근 제어, 보안 사고 조사, 고급 자료 보호와 규정 준수가 필요하다면 E5를 검토합니다. 업무용 Copilot은 사용할 사람에게 별도로 추가할 수 있습니다. 이미 쓰는 보안 제품과 겹치는 기능, 정책을 운영할 인력도 함께 확인하세요.

E5 수준의 보호와 업무용 Copilot에 더해 Entra Suite와 Agent 365를 실제로 함께 사용할 계획이 있는지 확인합니다. Entra Suite: Internet Access·Private Access, ID Governance, ID Protection과 Verified ID의 프리미엄 기능을 포함합니다. E5의 Entra ID P2와 Suite 전체는 구분해야 합니다. Entra 라이선스와 Suite 구성을 참고하세요. Agent 365: 에이전트의 접근·보안·수명주기를 관리할 때 검토합니다. 에이전트 개발 도구나 모든 실행 비용까지 자동으로 해결되는 것은 아닙니다. 할당 대상: 모든 직원에게 일괄 배정하기 전에 해당 기능을 사용할 직무와 운영 담당자를 정하세요. 사용자 수와 실제 이용 범위에 맞춰 혼합 구성을 비교합니다.

상품명과 Teams 포함 여부, 사용자별 할당 서비스 플랜을 확인합니다. Copilot Chat의 웹 기반 답변과 회사 자료를 참조하는 Microsoft 365 Copilot을 구분합니다. 필요한 보안·Purview·Intune 기능을 서비스 설명과 맞춰 봅니다. E7이라는 이름만으로 모든 추가 기능이 포함된다고 판단하지 마세요. 이용 지역·클라우드와 순차 배포 상태를 확인하고 대표 사용자로 시험합니다.

E7 견적은 E5·Copilot·Entra Suite·Agent 365를 필요한 사용자에게 각각 구성한 견적과 비교하세요. 사용하지 않을 기능까지 비용 절감으로 계산하지 않습니다. E7에 Copilot이 포함돼도 모든 AI 작업이 무제한으로 제공되는 것은 아닙니다. Cowork·Code 등 Copilot Credits를 사용하는 서비스는 사용량과 지출 한도를 확인해야 합니다. 서비스마다 지원하는 사전 구매·종량제·용량 요금 조합이 다르므로 Copilot Credits 과금 안내를 확인하세요.

documents.t: Microsoft licensing decisions should be reviewed as a feature entitlement and control-mapping exercise. The important question is not "how much did the SKU change?" The important question is "which capabilities are actually included, which service plans are enabled, and which security or AI controls can now be designed without an additional product assumption?" This is especially important when comparing Office 365 E3, Microsoft 365 E3, Microsoft 365 E5, Microsoft 365 E7, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Entra, Intune, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio.

Microsoft 라이선스를 검토할 때는 가격과 함께 포함 기능이 어떻게 달라졌는지 확인해야 합니다. 예를 들어 고객이 "E3를 사용 중"이라고 말하더라도 그것이 Office 365 E3인지, Microsoft 365 E3인지에 따라 포함되는 보안, 기기 관리, ID, 규정 준수 기능이 달라질 수 있습니다. 또한 Microsoft 문서에서는 Microsoft 365 E3 같은 일부 구독에 Defender for Office 365 Plan 1이 포함될 수 있다고 설명하므로, 상품 이름만으로 보안 구성을 결정하지 마세요. 따라서 라이선스를 검토할 때는 상품명과 서비스 플랜 식별자를 확인하고, 포함 기능이 대상 사용자에게 활성화돼 있는지 살펴보세요. E7도 사용자 할당과 정책 설정, 사용량 요금 확인이 필요합니다.

E7에는 E5의 기능과 Microsoft 365 Copilot·Microsoft Entra Suite·Microsoft Agent 365가 포함됩니다. Microsoft 공식 비교와 E3·E5·E7 비교에서 포함 기능과 비용 조건을 확인하세요. E5+Copilot에는 Entra Suite·Agent 365 전체가 자동으로 포함되지 않습니다. 기존 구독과 겹치는 기능을 먼저 확인하고 Copilot Credits 사용량 요금을 별도로 계산하세요.

The Microsoft 365 admin center, PowerShell and Microsoft Graph can show the same product using different identifiers. For example, Office 365 E3 can appear as a friendly product name, as the ENTERPRISEPACK string ID, or as a GUID in Graph. The real design work starts when the architect reviews the service plans included in that SKU and confirms whether the required service plans are enabled for the target users.
documents.s: Why SKU Names Are Not Enough

documents.t: Use this pattern when a customer says they have "E3". Question Why It Matters Is it Office 365 E3 or Microsoft 365 E3? Microsoft 365 E3 includes additional identity, endpoint and security capabilities compared with Office 365 productivity-only positioning. Which service plans are enabled? A purchased license does not guarantee every service plan is enabled for every user. Is Defender for Office 365 Plan 1 included or separately licensed? Email security architecture changes if Safe Links, Safe Attachments and impersonation protection are available. Is Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Plan 1 included? Endpoint protection baseline changes if MDE P1 capability is available. Which Purview features are available? DLP, retention, audit and information protection depend on actual plan capability. Are add-ons overlapping with bundled capability? Some add-ons may no longer be needed if the bundled entitlement already covers the control.

Capability Layer Practical Meaning Built-in security for cloud mailboxes baseline anti-malware, anti-spam, anti-phishing, quarantine, submissions, message trace Defender for Office 365 Plan 1 Safe Links, Safe Attachments, impersonation protection, real-time detections, user tags and Teams protection features Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 Threat Explorer, attack simulation training, Threat Trackers, AIR and advanced hunting/investigation patterns

Copilot Studio should be reviewed across two dimensions: Maker access: tenant license and Copilot Studio User License. Runtime and scale: billed sessions, Copilot Credits, agent type, orchestration, knowledge and tools. The platform itself has also changed. New agent experience, Microsoft IQ, Work IQ, reusable skills, memory, computer use, agent inventory, Entra agent identities, A2A and automated evaluations now affect governance design.

Build a service plan inventory. Identify the customer's actual E3/E5/E7/Business Premium mix and separately purchased Copilot, Entra and Agent 365 subscriptions. Map each required control to an included or missing feature. Validate Defender, Purview, Entra and Intune entitlement before add-on recommendations. documents.t: Microsoft 공식 비교에 따르면 Microsoft 365 E7은 E5에 Microsoft 365 Copilot·Microsoft Entra Suite·Agent 365를 묶은 구성입니다. E3·E5·E7 비교에서 포함 기능, E5+Copilot과의 차이, Teams 구성과 비용을 함께 확인하세요. E3·E5·E7 모두 Teams 포함·미포함 상품과 이용 지역, 구매 경로와 계약 조건을 확인합니다. 웹 기반 Copilot Chat과 회사 자료를 참조하는 Microsoft 365 Copilot을 구분합니다. E3·E5에서는 업무용 Copilot 추가 구독을, E7에서는 포함된 구독과 별도 사용량 요금을 확인합니다. Conditional Access generally requires Entra ID P1; user/sign-in risk policies require P2. Agent policies have separate licensing and preview conditions. See the Conditional Access guide. The US page is not a Korean quotation. Confirm currency, taxes, commitment, region and renewal terms for the actual offer.

Microsoft 365와 보안·Copilot 기능의 라이선스 조건을 확인하는 자료입니다. 사용자 업무와 필요한 기능, 기기 관리와 보안 요구사항을 정한 뒤 기존 구독과 추가 기능을 비교하세요. 실제 서비스 플랜과 계약 조건을 확인한 뒤 구매안을 결정합니다.

Microsoft 365 renewal and Copilot expansion conversations should include a feature entitlement review. Customers need a clear view of included service plans, enabled user-level capabilities, Defender/Purview/Entra/Intune controls, Copilot readiness and agent consumption. E3는 협업과 기본 관리, E5는 고급 보안·규정 준수, E7은 E5에 업무용 Copilot과 에이전트 관리를 함께 도입할 때 검토하는 구성입니다. E7에는 Microsoft 365 E5 + Microsoft 365 Copilot + Microsoft Entra Suite + Microsoft Agent 365가 포함됩니다. E5에 Copilot만 추가하는 경우와는 구성과 비용이 다릅니다. 필요한 기능과 사용할 사람을 정한 뒤 기존 구독·추가 기능과 비교하세요.

기준일은 2026년 10월 26일입니다. 아래는 Microsoft 365 기업용 플랜의 비교이며 Office 365 E3·E5와 구분합니다. Teams 포함·미포함 상품과 이용 지역, 계약 조건을 확인하세요. 기능 포함 여부는 Microsoft의 E3·E5·E7 비교, E7의 구성은 E7 제품 안내를 기준으로 정리했습니다. 라이선스를 구매한 뒤에도 사용자 할당과 정책 설정이 필요합니다.
협업, 기기 관리, 보안 조사, 자료 보호와 AI 사용 중 필요한 업무를 고릅니다. 현재 구독과 사용자별 서비스 플랜, 따로 구매한 보안·Copilot 기능을 확인합니다. E3·E5·E7과 필요한 추가 기능을 같은 요구사항으로 비교합니다. 실제 사용할 사용자 수, 구독료, 사용량 요금과 운영 담당자를 정합니다.

Microsoft Security Copilot과 일반 업무용 Microsoft 365 Copilot은 다른 제품입니다. Security Copilot의 적격 조건과 제공 범위를 별도로 확인하세요.
메일·문서·협업과 계정·기기 관리가 중심이고, 고급 보안 기능이 일부 사용자나 특정 업무에만 필요하다면 E3와 필요한 추가 기능을 비교합니다. Copilot 도입이나 Zero Trust 설계만으로 E5·E7 구매가 결정되지는 않습니다.
위험 기반 접근 제어, 보안 사고 조사, 고급 자료 보호와 규정 준수가 필요하다면 E5를 검토합니다. 업무용 Copilot은 사용할 사람에게 별도로 추가할 수 있습니다. 이미 쓰는 보안 제품과 겹치는 기능, 정책을 운영할 인력도 함께 확인하세요.

E5 수준의 보호와 업무용 Copilot에 더해 Entra Suite와 Agent 365를 실제로 함께 사용할 계획이 있는지 확인합니다. Entra Suite: Internet Access·Private Access, ID Governance, ID Protection과 Verified ID의 프리미엄 기능을 포함합니다. E5의 Entra ID P2와 Suite 전체는 구분해야 합니다. Entra 라이선스와 Suite 구성을 참고하세요. Cutover moves the organization in one event. Microsoft documents a maximum of 2,000 mailboxes and recommends 150 or fewer for a manageable migration window. The 150 figure is a planning recommendation, not a technical hard limit. Confirm source-version prerequisites and directory synchronization constraints in the cutover procedure.

Staged migration is the legacy method for Exchange 2003 or 2007. It is not a general recommendation for medium-sized organizations and does not support Exchange 2010 or later. For a supported modern Exchange estate, evaluate hybrid remote moves or another documented migration path. See staged migration requirements.

Use hybrid remote moves when the supported source configuration and coexistence requirements justify them. Validate the Hybrid Configuration Wizard prerequisites, identity synchronization, certificates, mail routing and free/busy before selecting the approach. Organization size alone does not determine the migration method. See Exchange hybrid deployments.

Suitable: Merger Acquisition Divestiture Tools: Microsoft Migration Orchestrator for supported workloads Quest BitTitan AvePoint Fly Microsoft Migration Orchestrator coordinates Exchange mailboxes, OneDrive, Teams chats and Teams meetings. It moves content, not identities; prepare identity mapping and the required user configuration separately. Teams meetings require both chats and mailbox migration in the batch. SharePoint sites, Teams channels, apps and device policies need separate migration plans. Check the per-user Cross Tenant User Data Migration add-on and workload exclusions in the orchestrator documentation.

documents.t: Microsoft 365 licensing should translate business requirements into the right mix of productivity, security, compliance, device management and AI capabilities. The goal is not simply to minimize cost. The goal is to avoid paying for unused capabilities while ensuring required controls are actually licensed.
필요한 업무 기능과 보안 정책을 Microsoft 365의 실제 서비스 플랜에 맞춰 확인하는 문서입니다. 사용자별 업무와 기기, 기존 구독과 추가 기능을 비교하세요. 구매한 상품명과 실제 사용 권한, 기능 활성화 상태는 각각 확인해야 합니다.

Microsoft 365 licensing discussions should include a feature entitlement review. The key question is not only which SKU is purchased, but which service plans are included, enabled and usable for the required security, compliance, endpoint, Copilot and agent controls. documents.s: Govern personal work files as part of the collaboration architecture

documents.t: OneDrive provides personal work file storage, synchronization and sharing in Microsoft 365. In enterprise design, OneDrive should be governed as part of the collaboration and data protection architecture. It affects external sharing, device sync, retention, DLP, migration and Copilot readiness. For regulated collaboration boundaries, OneDrive should also be reviewed with Microsoft Purview Information Barriers. Segment-based policies can affect file sharing, direct link access and search behavior when users belong to separated business groups.
OneDrive의 동기화, 외부 공유, 데이터 보존과 퇴사자 파일 처리를 정리했습니다. 폴더 이동과 공유 정책을 적용하기 전에 대상 사용자, 파일 소유자와 예외 처리 방법을 정하고 데이터 보호 정책을 확인하세요.

Configure sharing policy and sync restrictions. Enable known folder move where appropriate. Apply retention and DLP controls. Define migration approach for personal drives. Pilot with representative user groups. Monitor sync health and support issues.

Restrict sync to managed devices if required. Review anonymous and external sharing. Apply sensitivity labels and DLP. Validate Information Barriers behavior for Segment-based sharing restrictions where required. Use retention for user departure scenarios. Monitor risky sharing and oversharing.

documents.t: Microsoft 365 is the core productivity, collaboration, security and compliance platform for modern enterprises. This knowledge domain provides practical guidance for Microsoft 365 consulting, presales, architecture design, migration planning and operational governance. Enterprise Microsoft 365 work should be framed around business outcomes: secure collaboration, risk reduction, productivity, governance maturity, migration continuity and AI readiness.

documents.t: SharePoint Online should not be positioned as a simple file server replacement. A successful SharePoint implementation requires a well-designed information architecture, governance model, permission strategy, lifecycle policy and data protection framework. This framework provides a practical approach for designing SharePoint Online as an enterprise content and knowledge platform. Executive lens: SharePoint design should start with information architecture and governance, not site creation. Hub structure, permissions, labels, lifecycle and Copilot readiness must be designed together.

Typical SharePoint initiatives include: File server or NAS modernization Department document management Intranet implementation Project collaboration Enterprise knowledge management Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness Information protection and DLP implementation Information Barriers for regulated collaboration boundaries Global collaboration standardization

SharePoint administrators can mark selected sites as authoritative so official content such as policies, company news and approved guidance is prioritized in Copilot Search. Use this designation for a small, governed set of sources with accountable owners and a defined review cadence. documents.s: Decide whether to connect tenants or consolidate them

documents.t: Organizations frequently face the challenge of integrating multiple Microsoft 365 tenants after mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, regional compliance requirements, or operating model changes. There are two primary approaches: Cross-Tenant Synchronization Full Tenant Migration Selecting the wrong strategy can create significant operational, security, compliance, and user experience challenges. This document provides a decision framework used in enterprise Microsoft 365 transformation projects.
Examples: Subsidiary acquisition Business integration Organizational restructuring
Examples: GDPR German BDSG Local Data Residency
Examples: HQ and Regional Tenant Shared Services Model Multi-Tenant Governance

Decision FrameworkBusiness requirement to architecture path 01Business driverM&A, divestiture, regional compliance or global operating model. 02Identity modelOne user experience or controlled multi-tenant collaboration. 03Data boundaryLocal residency, legal entity autonomy and compliance ownership. 04Workload scopeExchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams and shared applications. 05AI readinessGraph boundary, search, permissions and Copilot knowledge quality. 06DecisionCross-Tenant Sync, coexistence runway or full tenant migration. Option 1

Cross-tenant synchronization provisions B2B collaboration users and supported security groups into a target tenant. It is a one-way provisioning process; source identities remain responsible for authentication. It does not migrate mailboxes, files or Teams content. See the supported objects and group limitations. Users remain in their original tenant. Data remains in its original tenant.

Cross-Tenant SynchronizationIdentity connection while data remains separated AHome tenantUsers, mailboxes, files, Teams data and regional policies remain local. BEntra SyncCross-tenant access settings, inbound/outbound trust and user synchronization. CPolicy boundaryConditional Access, MFA, guest controls and compliance rules remain tenant-aware. DResource tenantCollaboration access improves without moving workload data.
No mailbox migration. No SharePoint migration. No Teams migration.
A limited identity pilot may be quicker than a content migration, but duration depends on object count, attribute mapping, access policy, testing and approvals. Estimate the schedule after discovery.
Synchronization does not move workload content, but user attributes are provisioned into the target tenant. Review those data flows and cross-tenant access separately.
Mailboxes stay in source tenant. SharePoint remains separate. Teams remains separate.
Multiple tenant context. Potential collaboration complexity.
Multiple tenants remain. Multiple governance models remain.

documents.t: File server migration moves legacy shared folders into modern collaboration platforms such as SharePoint, OneDrive or Azure Files. The biggest risk is not the copy operation. The biggest risk is moving unmanaged folder structures, stale permissions and unclear ownership into a modern platform without governance.
파일 서버의 자료를 SharePoint나 OneDrive로 옮기기 전에 확인할 항목을 정리했습니다. 파일 소유자와 공유 권한을 정리하고 대상 저장 위치를 정합니다. 시험 이전에서 파일 수, 접근 권한과 사용자 업무를 확인한 뒤 전환하세요.

File server migration architectureCopy less, govern more 01File server sourceIdentify shares, owners, stale data, sensitive files and business-critical folders. 02Inventory and permission reviewClean duplicate data, inherited permissions, orphaned users and unclear ownership. 03Target platformChoose SharePoint, OneDrive or Azure Files based on collaboration and access needs. 04Information governanceApply lifecycle, permissions, labels, DLP, retention and Copilot readiness controls.

Inventory shares, size, file types and owners. Identify stale, duplicate and restricted data. Map target locations by business function. Review permissions and external sharing requirements. Run pilot migration and validate access. Execute migration waves with freeze and rollback plan. Decommission legacy shares after acceptance.

Remove orphaned permissions before migration. Avoid copying inherited access blindly. Use sensitivity labels where required. Validate external sharing settings. Keep rollback and read-only archive plans.

documents.s: Decide what to consolidate, federate or keep separate

documents.t: Global tenant consolidation is not only a migration project. It requires coordinated design across identity, domain, mail coexistence, security policy, compliance policy, data protection, regional administration and user communication. A successful tenant consolidation program should define whether the organization needs full migration, long-term coexistence or a hybrid multi-tenant operating model. Executive lens: Global tenant consolidation is a business operating model decision first and a migration decision second. The key question is which tenants should consolidate, federate, remain isolated or become transitional.

Typical scenarios include: Headquarters and regional subsidiaries using separate Microsoft 365 tenants Acquired companies requiring integration with the parent company Legacy mail systems coexisting with Exchange Online Shared SMTP domain or subdomain routing requirements Regional security and compliance policy differences Data protection and sensitivity label migration requirements Global governance standardization

A Copilot license assignment is necessary, but it is not sufficient evidence that every workload prerequisite is ready. Validate the deployed state for each pilot user: Prerequisite Deployment validation Eligible Microsoft 365 base license and Copilot license Confirm the assigned products and enabled service plans for the user. Microsoft Entra ID account Confirm the user can authenticate with the intended tenant identity and policy set. Exchange Online primary mailbox Verify that the primary mailbox is actually provisioned in Exchange Online. Microsoft 365 Copilot is not supported with an on-premises or hybrid primary mailbox, and archive, group, shared, and delegated mailboxes do not replace this requirement. Microsoft 365 Apps Deploy supported apps, review connected-experience privacy controls, and allow the Office Feature Updates task to run. OneDrive Provision OneDrive where the selected Copilot scenarios depend on OneDrive-backed features. Browser Enable third-party cookies when Word, Excel, or PowerPoint for the web requires them for Copilot. Network Allow Microsoft 365 endpoints and full WebSocket connectivity to *.cloud.microsoft and *.office.com; review TLS inspection, proxy timeout, and perimeter controls. Do not treat a client-side eligibility flag or an acquired license state as proof that the Exchange Online mailbox, OneDrive, network, and application dependencies have finished provisioning. documents.s: Troubleshooting Protected Documents in Copilot Chat

documents.t: In one controlled troubleshooting case, Copilot Chat could identify a sensitivity-labeled, encrypted SharePoint file but could not use the document body for grounding. The test account showed Copilot client eligibility and file-upload capability, while its Exchange Online primary mailbox had not been provisioned. After the primary mailbox was provisioned, the same user and encrypted document produced body-level citations and a successful summary without removing the label or encryption. This before-and-after result supports mailbox provisioning as the operational remediation for that case. It does not establish a publicly documented Microsoft backend call path, nor does it mean every protected-content failure has the same cause.

Reproduce safely. Use an approved test document and record the user, app, timestamp, prompt type, and expected access without publishing tenant or label identifiers. Validate source access. Confirm that the user can open the SharePoint or OneDrive file directly and that file permissions, sharing links, label publishing scope, and encryption rights are valid. Separate policy evidence from UI text. Review DLP and sensitivity-label policy results for an explicit block action. A generic policy message is not sufficient evidence of Purview enforcement. Verify the workload, not only the license. Confirm an Exchange Online primary mailbox exists and is usable. Do not infer provisioning from Copilot eligibility, license acquisition, or an enabled Exchange service plan alone. Check application and network prerequisites. Validate supported Microsoft 365 Apps, connected experiences, third-party cookies where required, Microsoft 365 endpoints, WSS connectivity, TLS inspection, and proxy timeouts. Retest without weakening protection. Keep the same label, encryption, permissions, and network path where possible. Change one variable at a time and compare the failed and successful grounding results. Validate compliance handling. Confirm the intended Purview retention policy location and use eDiscovery evidence rather than the visible Copilot chat history to verify retention or deletion.

Eligible base license and Microsoft 365 Copilot license are assigned. Exchange Online primary mailbox is provisioned and verified for every pilot user. Microsoft Entra ID, supported apps, privacy controls, browser settings, and OneDrive-dependent scenarios are validated. Microsoft 365 endpoints and WSS to *.cloud.microsoft and *.office.com are allowed through proxies and inspection controls. SharePoint permissions, sensitivity-label publishing scope, encryption rights, and DLP mode are documented. Failed and successful tests use the same protected content and change one dependency at a time. Copilot and AI-app retention locations, retention periods, holds, and eDiscovery validation are approved by compliance owners. Evidence excludes customer names, tenant IDs, label GUIDs, packet captures, and document contents from public documentation.

This is an assessment decision taxonomy, not a product ranking or a Microsoft score. Map each business requirement to the current capability and evidence, define the target outcome, and choose Retain, Replace, Integrate, Remediate or Defer. A replacement decision requires a documented gap, transition risk and dependency review; integration must identify the authoritative control and overlapping responsibilities. 표를 좌우로 스크롤하면 모든 열을 볼 수 있습니다. A Secure Score recommendation or third-party/alternate-mitigation status is useful evidence, but Microsoft notes that it doesn't verify the completeness of third-party implementation. Assign one accountable business, security, compliance, IT operations, platform or finance/procurement owner. Record identity, endpoint, data classification, network, migration and operating-model dependencies as applicable. Validate license impact against current service descriptions and the customer's agreement; don't infer entitlement from a product name or Secure Score alone. 이 표는 제품 우열이나 Microsoft 점수가 아니라 평가용 의사결정 체계입니다. 각 비즈니스 요구사항에 현재 역량과 증거, 목표 결과를 연결하고 유지, 교체, 통합, 개선 또는 보류를 선택합니다. 교체에는 확인된 공백, 전환 위험과 의존성 검토가 필요하며, 통합에는 기준이 되는 통제와 중복 책임을 명시합니다. 프로젝트 증거 수준은 E1 인터뷰, E2 승인된 정책·설계 문서, E3 확인된 테넌트 설정·할당 서비스 플랜, E4 범위가 명확한 로그·사용량·사고 운영 증거로 기록합니다. 출처, 범위와 확인일을 남기고 근거가 없거나 충돌하는 주장은 확인 필요로 유지합니다. Secure Score와 타사 또는 대체 완화 상태는 참고 증거이며, Microsoft는 타사 구현의 완전성을 확인하지 않는다고 안내합니다. 각 항목에는 책임자 한 명, 기술·운영 선행조건, 우선순위와 라이선스 영향을 기록합니다. 라이선스 영향은 없음, 기존 권리, 추가 기능, 사용량, 타사 또는 확인 필요로 구분하고 현재 서비스 설명과 고객 계약으로 확인합니다.

Microsoft Migration Orchestrator는 메일, OneDrive, Teams 채팅·모임을 함께 옮길 수 있습니다. 계정 자체와 SharePoint 사이트·Teams 채널은 별도로 준비해야 합니다. 지원 범위와 선행 조건을 확인하세요. 하나의 테넌트에서도 사용자·기기 그룹에 따라 지역별 정책을 다르게 적용할 수 있습니다. 제품별 할당 범위와 예외 처리 방식을 확인하세요. Supported Controls​ Conditional Access Intune Policy DLP Sensitivity Labels Defender Policies SharePoint Access Control Design Principle​ 정책을 사용자·기기 그룹에 할당하고 담당자가 그룹 구성원과 예외를 관리합니다. 도메인 이름만으로 조직의 정책 경계가 만들어지지는 않습니다.

documents.s: Move from scattered agent ideas to a governed portfolio

documents.t: A large enterprise organization wanted to move beyond generic Copilot training and identify practical AI Agent opportunities across business functions. The working patterns included research reporting, pricing analysis, HR data inquiry, market intelligence, ESG and risk review, proposal support and internal knowledge search. The objective was to convert scattered AI ideas into a governed Agent portfolio with clear ownership, data boundaries, pilot criteria and reusable delivery assets.
Copilot Studio로 업무 자동화 후보를 검토하고 에이전트의 승인·배포·운영 절차를 정리한 사례입니다. 고객명과 내부 프로젝트명은 제외했습니다. 업종별 업무 예시, 담당자 역할과 운영 기준을 참고하세요.

AI Agent ideas existed across multiple departments but were not prioritized consistently. Business users needed examples that connected Copilot Studio with real work, not only product features. Some agent candidates required sensitive business data, approval workflow or human review. Agent prototypes needed lifecycle governance before broader rollout. Executives needed a portfolio view showing value, risk, readiness and delivery sequence.

Business Area Anonymized Agent Pattern Expected Value Research and R&D Portfolio review and report drafting Agent Reduce manual report preparation and improve review consistency Marketing and market intelligence Market sensing and keyword monitoring Agent Support faster market trend analysis and executive briefing Pricing and commercial operations Pricing analysis Agent using market, freight and FX inputs Improve pricing review speed and decision traceability HR and corporate operations HR data inquiry and policy Q&A Agent Reduce repetitive internal inquiries and improve employee experience ESG and risk management Greenwashing and compliance risk review Agent Improve evidence-based risk review and governance Proposal and presales Proposal, SOW and executive summary drafting Agent Accelerate proposal production while keeping review control

Agent Factory ArchitectureUse case intake to lifecycle monitoring 01Use Case IntakeCapture business pain, target users, expected value and repeated work pattern. 02Value / Risk FitScore feasibility, data sensitivity, action risk, reuse potential and pilot priority. 03Agent DesignDefine knowledge sources, tools, permissions, human review and expected outputs. 04Security ReviewValidate identity, data boundary, DLP, audit, approval and publishing controls. 05Pilot and CatalogBuild limited pilots, collect feedback and register approved agents in a catalog. 06OperateMonitor value, quality, incidents, usage, cost and retirement readiness.

Collect candidate Agent ideas from business teams and existing proposal or prototype materials. Normalize the ideas into a common use case intake format. Score each candidate by business value, data readiness, risk, complexity and reusability. Separate knowledge-only Agents from action-capable Agents. Define ownership, source data, permission boundary and human review point. Build a small number of pilot Agents using Copilot Studio or Agent Builder. Establish Agent Factory governance before expanding the portfolio.

Governance Area Recommended Control Ownership Assign both business owner and technical owner for each Agent Data access Validate knowledge sources, permissions, DLP and sensitivity labels Approval Require review before publishing department or enterprise Agents Human oversight Define which outputs require review before business action Monitoring Track usage, failure patterns, user feedback and business value Lifecycle Review, update, retire or consolidate Agents periodically

AI Agent opportunity assessment Agent use case intake template Agent prioritization matrix Copilot Studio pilot plan Agent design document Agent governance and approval model Enterprise Agent catalog Agent Factory operating model Executive AI Agent roadmap

Metric Area Example Measure Portfolio number of Agent candidates collected, prioritized and approved Readiness data sources validated, owners assigned, risk items closed Adoption pilot users, feedback score, repeated usage Productivity report drafting time reduction, inquiry deflection, review cycle improvement Governance Agents with owner, approval, monitoring and retirement plan Quality human review findings, incorrect response rate, escalation count

Agent programs need a portfolio model before broad creation is allowed. The best first Agents are narrow, high-frequency and measurable. Data readiness and permission design matter more than prompt quality alone. Action-capable Agents require stronger approval and audit controls than Q&A Agents. Agent Factory governance prevents duplicate Agents and unmanaged automation sprawl.

An enterprise group needed consistent identity, device and collaboration governance across multiple business units. The environment required clear policy decisions, operating ownership and a roadmap for tenant and workload governance.

Business units had different identity and device standards. Intune and Entra ID policies needed consistent design. Device compliance and enrollment exceptions needed operational handling. Collaboration governance required ownership and lifecycle decisions. Multi-tenant decisions needed a business-aligned target model.

The strongest pattern is to document decisions in a policy workbook. Enterprise governance fails when decisions stay informal. A workbook creates traceability across security, operations and business stakeholders.

For executive review, this pattern should be positioned as a governance standardization program. The business value is not only better policy documentation. It is reduced ambiguity across business units, clearer tenant strategy, faster exception decisions and safer expansion for Copilot, AI agents and collaboration services.

Outcome Practical Meaning Consistent baseline group-wide identity, device and collaboration controls become easier to explain and operate Better exception control exceptions have owners, expiry dates and compensating controls Reduced operational ambiguity support teams know which policy applies and where to escalate Executive visibility tenant strategy and governance roadmap can be reviewed as business decisions Safer expansion Copilot, AI Agent and collaboration initiatives can build on clearer data and access controls

Metric What To Track Baseline adoption percentage of business units aligned to the common identity, device and collaboration baseline Exception quality exceptions with owner, expiry date, approval reason and compensating control Tenant clarity tenants classified as strategic, transitional, regulated, legacy or innovation Operations readiness support and escalation paths documented for policy and device issues Executive visibility governance decisions summarized in a recurring review pack

Separate global baseline policy from business-unit exceptions. Make exception ownership explicit. Use dynamic groups carefully and document membership logic. Connect tenant strategy to business ownership, not only technical preference.

SaaS access had to satisfy internal network and security requirements. Microsoft 365 and Copilot usage needed a data protection baseline. Conditional Access, endpoint posture and network controls had to work together. Security exceptions required owners, expiry dates and compensating controls. Architecture had to be readable by security, infrastructure and business stakeholders.

For regulated environments, success depends on evidence-ready governance. Architecture diagrams alone are not enough. The delivery must include control ownership, exception handling and operational review rhythm.

A distributed logistics organization needed to modernize mail and collaboration while minimizing disruption for business users and operations teams. The project required migration readiness, mail flow validation, security review, administrator guidance and post-cutover support planning.

Mail migration had to preserve business continuity. Mail flow, DNS, firewall and endpoint dependencies needed early validation. Security configuration had to be reviewed before broad production use. Administrators needed practical operating procedures after handover. User communication and hypercare were required for adoption stability.

This pattern should be framed as a business continuity modernization effort. The value is not only Exchange Online migration. It is stable mail flow, verified dependencies, user communication, rollback readiness and administrator handover.
The most reusable pattern is to pair migration planning with security and operations handover. Migration is not complete when data moves; it is complete when operations can support the new service.

A large manufacturing organization wanted to introduce Microsoft 365 Copilot while controlling data exposure, license value, user readiness and executive expectations. The environment included office workers, distributed business teams, strict governance expectations and a need to connect adoption planning with security readiness.

Copilot value needed to be explained in business scenarios, not only feature demonstrations. Security and data readiness had to be reviewed before broad enablement. License assignment needed a phased and measurable plan. User enablement had to align with business roles and work patterns. Executives required a roadmap, WBS, governance model and value tracking approach.

In manufacturing, logistics and enterprise group environments, the strongest outcomes usually come from turning scattered Microsoft 365 settings into a single operating model. The value is not only better configuration; it is better ownership, repeatable review, and a roadmap that executives can understand.

Service ownership is clear across identity, endpoint, messaging and collaboration. Risk items are prioritized by business impact, not only technical severity. Users receive stable collaboration patterns instead of ad-hoc workspace creation. Operations can maintain the environment using documented policies and procedures.

An anonymized enterprise group governance engagement typically follows this pattern: Collect tenant inventory and business ownership information. Separate technical consolidation opportunities from business separation requirements. Define a minimum security baseline across all tenants. Establish tenant role classification and exception approval. Build a roadmap for identity, collaboration, security and migration workstreams. Create executive reporting that explains risk, cost and operational impact.

Metric What To Track Tenant classification all tenants assigned strategic, transitional, regulated, legacy or innovation role Baseline alignment minimum identity, security and collaboration controls defined for each tenant Exception control exceptions documented with owner, reason, expiry and compensating control Migration clarity workloads mapped to consolidate, federate, isolate or migrate decisions Operating ownership platform owner, support path and review cadence assigned

Do not treat tenant consolidation as a purely technical decision. Classify tenants before planning migration waves. Define a minimum security baseline even for transitional or legacy tenants. Keep regulated or business-separated tenants explicit in the roadmap. Report tenant strategy as business risk, cost and operating model, not only architecture.

Internal network or SaaS usage requires formal security approval. The organization must support Copilot or Microsoft 365 expansion without increasing data exposure. Conditional Access, Defender, Purview and Intune controls are not yet connected into one architecture. Security teams need control evidence for committees, audits or executive review.

In finance, healthcare, manufacturing and regulated SaaS environments, security modernization succeeds when the project produces approval evidence, not only configuration changes. Security teams need a clear explanation of what is controlled, who owns exceptions and how the control will be reviewed after rollout.

Security controls are mapped to business risks and approval evidence. Exceptions have owners, expiry dates and compensating controls. Microsoft 365 and Copilot adoption can proceed with clear data protection guardrails. Security and IT operations share the same control language.

Security modernization succeeds when evidence is planned from the beginning. Conditional Access, Defender, Purview and Intune should be explained as one control model. Copilot and AI adoption make permission cleanup and data protection more urgent. Exception governance is often more important than the initial policy setting. documents.t: An executive summary translates technical scope into business outcomes, risk reduction, investment rationale and decision points. For Microsoft 365, Security, Copilot, Azure and migration proposals, this section should help executives understand why the program matters, what value it creates and what decision is required.

제안서의 경영진 요약에는 해결할 문제, 기대 결과, 비용과 위험, 필요한 결정을 짧게 적습니다. 기술 기능을 나열하기보다 도입 이유와 지금 결정해야 할 사항이 무엇인지 설명하세요. 좋은 Executive Summary는 "무엇을 구축할 것인가"보다 "왜 지금 해야 하는가", "하지 않으면 어떤 리스크가 남는가", "승인 후 어떤 변화가 생기는가"를 먼저 설명합니다.

Question Why It Matters What business issue is being solved? Keeps the proposal outcome-led What risk is reduced? Helps CISO, CFO and CIO alignment What changes for users or operations? Clarifies adoption and support impact What investment is required? Supports funding decision What happens if no action is taken? Makes urgency visible What decision is required now? Converts proposal review into action

Use this style: This program establishes a secure Microsoft 365 foundation that improves collaboration, strengthens data protection and prepares the organization for Copilot adoption through a phased governance and security roadmap. Avoid this style: We will configure Microsoft 365 features and provide documentation.

Lead with business outcome before product capability. Name the risk of inaction. Keep Microsoft product names precise, but explain the business implication in natural language. Avoid listing every feature; group capabilities into outcome areas. State what decision is required from the executive sponsor. Link the summary to the SOW, WBS and governance model so the message can be executed.

documents.t: A Risk Register is used to identify, assess, track and mitigate risks throughout a Microsoft cloud consulting engagement. For Microsoft 365, Azure, Security, Copilot and migration projects, risk management must cover not only technical issues but also licensing, business readiness, change management, operational ownership and executive decision dependencies. Asset preview: Use this page to understand the risk model. For an editable risk register file or customer-ready sample, request the asset through Contact and Asset Request with the project type and target workload. Risk Register FlowRisk discovery to executive reporting 01IdentifyTechnical, business, license, change, migration and governance risks. 02ClassifyImpact, probability, risk level and escalation trigger. 03Assign OwnerDecision maker, mitigation lead, due date and dependency owner. 04MitigateActions, fallback, dates, dependencies and residual exposure. 05ReportStatus, escalation, executive decisions and closure evidence.

This template is typically used for: Microsoft 365 implementation projects Security and Zero Trust initiatives Tenant-to-tenant migration Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migration File server to SharePoint and Teams migration Copilot readiness and adoption programs Enterprise licensing and governance projects

documents.t: A Statement of Work defines the agreed scope, deliverables, assumptions, exclusions, responsibilities and acceptance criteria for a customer engagement. For Microsoft consulting projects, a strong SOW prevents ambiguity between presales promises and delivery execution. It should connect architecture decisions to measurable work packages.

SOW는 프로젝트에서 수행할 작업과 제공할 결과물, 책임과 인수 조건을 정하는 문서입니다. 포함·제외 범위, 선행 조건과 고객이 준비할 사항을 명시하고, 변경 요청이 생겼을 때의 승인 절차도 정합니다. 작업 시작 조건과 제출할 결과물, 검토 방법과 완료 승인 기준을 고객과 합의해 SOW에 기록합니다. Asset preview: This page explains the SOW design model. Editable SOW templates and sanitized customer-ready examples are shared by request after confirming scope, audience and confidentiality requirements.

SOW Design FlowBusiness driver to change control 01Business DriverClarify why the engagement matters now. 02Scope BoundaryWorkloads, users, tenants, regions, environments and responsibilities. 03DeliverablesReviewable outputs, workshops, design documents and handover assets. 04Assumptions / ExclusionsCustomer inputs, access, dependencies and out-of-scope requests. 05Acceptance CriteriaEvidence, review path, sign-off and completion definition. 06Change ControlAdditional scope decision, approval and commercial handling.

Section Purpose Project Background Explain business context and current challenge Objectives Define measurable business and technical outcomes Scope Identify workloads, users, tenants, regions and deliverables Deliverables List customer-reviewable outputs Assumptions State required customer inputs and dependencies Exclusions Clarify what is not included Roles and Responsibilities Define customer and delivery team ownership Timeline Summarize phases and milestones Acceptance Criteria Define how completion is approved

Workstream Example Deliverable Assessment Current state assessment and risk findings Architecture Target-state architecture and decision log Security Conditional Access, Defender, Purview or DLP design Migration Migration wave plan and cutover runbook Adoption Communication, training and champion enablement plan Handover Operation guide and knowledge transfer

Decision Recommended Question Scope boundary Which workloads, users and geographies are included? Deliverables What will the customer formally review and approve? Assumptions Which dependencies must the customer provide? Exclusions What likely requests are explicitly out of scope? Acceptance What evidence confirms completion? Change control How are additional requests priced and approved?

Gate Required Check Example Evidence Scope gate Each workload, tenant, region and user group is explicitly included or excluded scope table, out-of-scope list Dependency gate Customer responsibilities are visible before kickoff access request list, data inventory request, stakeholder list Deliverable gate Every activity maps to a reviewable output assessment report, architecture diagram, configuration evidence Acceptance gate Completion can be approved without subjective debate test result, workshop sign-off, handover checklist Change gate Additional requests have a defined approval path change request process and escalation owner

Describing only activities without deliverables Leaving assumptions vague or hidden Not defining exclusions for adjacent workloads Using timeline dates without dependency conditions Omitting acceptance criteria and handover scope Mixing proposal language and delivery language so the project team cannot execute the document directly

Use wording like this: This engagement covers Microsoft 365 security and governance assessment for the agreed tenant scope. The deliverables include current-state findings, prioritized recommendations, policy design guidance, implementation backlog and executive summary. Production configuration, end-user communication and adjacent workload implementation are excluded unless agreed through change control. Avoid wording like this: We will support Microsoft 365 security and governance as needed.

The WBS is the delivery control layer that connects proposal scope, technical work, acceptance criteria and project governance. For Microsoft 365, Security, Copilot and migration engagements, the WBS should not be a simple task list. It should show how discovery findings become architecture decisions, how implementation tasks are validated, and how customer acceptance is collected. documents.s: Convert proposal scope into controlled work packages and acceptance evidence

documents.t: WBS Control FlowSOW scope to operations handover 01SOW ScopeDeliverables, assumptions, exclusions and approved boundaries. 02WorkstreamsIdentity, endpoint, security, collaboration, Copilot or migration. 03Work PackagesOwner, activity, dependency, schedule and acceptance condition. 04EvidenceTest result, export, workshop record, report and validation artifact. 05AcceptanceCustomer review, sign-off, issue handling and decision record. 06HandoverOperation guide, backlog, support model and closure report.

Phase Objective Representative Activities Key Deliverables Discover Understand business and technical context Stakeholder workshop, tenant review, security baseline review, dependency collection Discovery report, requirement register Analyze Convert findings into risk and scope Gap analysis, licensing review, migration complexity assessment, governance review Assessment summary, risk register Design Define target-state architecture Microsoft 365 architecture, identity model, security controls, Copilot readiness, migration approach Architecture design, implementation plan Build Configure and prepare the environment Policy configuration, pilot tenant setup, migration tooling, governance artifacts Configuration evidence, pilot checklist Validate Confirm readiness and acceptance Functional test, security validation, user acceptance, rollback test Test result, acceptance record Deploy Execute controlled rollout Production change, migration batch, policy deployment, communication Deployment report, cutover log Close Transfer knowledge and stabilize operations Admin handover, operation guide, issue backlog, lessons learned Handover pack, closure report

Each work package should have one accountable owner. Each task should map to a deliverable or acceptance condition. Security, governance and change management should be built into the WBS, not added as afterthoughts. Customer-side tasks should be visible, especially approvals, account provisioning, test participation and communication. Migration and Copilot workstreams should include pilot, rollback and adoption tasks.

Workstream Typical Scope Acceptance Evidence Identity Entra ID, MFA, Conditional Access, role model Policy export, test account result, exception list Endpoint Intune enrollment, compliance policy, device baseline Enrollment report, compliance dashboard Security Defender, Purview, DLP, audit logging Alert validation, policy review, risk acceptance Collaboration Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive Service validation, permission review Copilot Readiness, data governance, pilot users, adoption Readiness score, pilot feedback, adoption plan Migration Inventory, batch plan, cutover, rollback Migration report, reconciliation result Governance RACI, approval model, operation rhythm Governance workbook, meeting cadence

Criteria Good WBS Behavior Risk if Missing Traceability Every task maps back to SOW scope or accepted change request delivery team performs unapproved work Ownership Each work package has accountable owner and customer dependency tasks wait without escalation Evidence Validation output is defined before implementation starts completion becomes subjective Phase control Discovery, design, build, validate, deploy and close are separated project jumps to configuration too early Governance Decision gates and escalation points are visible risks are discovered late Adoption Communication, training and handover are included where user impact exists technical success does not translate into adoption

For a manufacturing group rollout, a phased WBS separated identity, security, collaboration and adoption workstreams. This helped the customer approve security policy changes independently from user adoption tasks, reducing decision delay during pilot expansion. For a regulated financial SaaS environment, the WBS included explicit evidence tasks for Conditional Access, Defender and Purview validation. This made the final handover easier because the operations team could trace each security control back to a tested deliverable.

Is every proposal deliverable represented in the WBS? Are customer responsibilities clearly visible? Are approval gates defined before production deployment? Are rollback and exception processes included? Does the WBS distinguish pilot, production and handover activities? Can the project manager derive status reporting directly from the WBS? Can each workstream produce evidence that the customer can review? Are Security, Copilot and migration tasks separated enough to avoid ownership confusion?

Business-owned workflowCopilot Studio agentGood for knowledge-grounded assistants and low-code iteration. Focus on connector permissions, publishing approval and usage monitoring. Microsoft 365 flowAgent Builder / M365 agentGood for productivity scenarios inside Microsoft 365. Focus on data boundary, user education and lifecycle ownership. Custom applicationMicrosoft 365 Agents SDKGood for deeper enterprise app integration. Focus on identity, API permission, source control and DevSecOps. Advanced orchestrationMicrosoft Foundry agentGood for model orchestration and broader Azure AI integration. Focus on model governance, cost control and evaluation. Coordinated workMulti-agent patternGood for specialist agents working across tasks. Focus on orchestration boundary, human review and failure handling.

An AI Agent Factory is an operating model for turning business agent ideas into governed, reusable and measurable agents. It includes intake, prioritization, design, approval, build, publishing, monitoring and retirement.

documents.t: No. Copilot Studio is a strong fit for many business-owned agent scenarios, but an enterprise Agent Factory can also include Microsoft 365 Agents, Microsoft 365 Agents SDK, Microsoft Foundry and multi-agent patterns.
documents.s: Is Agent Factory only about Copilot Studio?

documents.t: Review business value, data source, permission boundary, action risk, human approval, owner, cost model, lifecycle and evaluation criteria before build starts.
documents.s: What should be reviewed before building an agent?

documents.t: Do not build an agent when the process is unclear, data ownership is weak, approval responsibility is missing, or the same result can be achieved with a simpler Copilot prompt or workflow.
documents.s: When should an agent not be built?

documents.t: Measure reuse, task completion, quality, user satisfaction, incident count, cost consumption, review effort and whether the agent reduces manual work without increasing risk.

documents.t: AI를 사용할 업무를 먼저 고릅니다. 문서 작성, 자료 분석, 회의 요약이나 여러 단계의 작업 중 어떤 부분을 맡길지 정하고 결과를 검토할 담당자를 지정하세요. 다음 항목을 참고해 도구와 적용 범위를 정할 수 있습니다. Copilot으로 개인 업무 생산성을 높입니다. 복잡한 문서나 분석에는 추론 모델을 사용하고, 근거와 계산 결과를 담당자가 확인합니다. 반복되는 업무는 Copilot Studio Agent로 전환합니다. Microsoft 365 업무 맥락 안에서는 M365 Agents를 활용합니다. 여러 단계의 업무를 Cowork에 맡길 때는 담당자, 작업 승인과 비용 기준을 정합니다.

AccessCan Copilot expose overshared content?Overshared data can become easier to discover through AI-assisted answers. DataAre sensitive repositories governed?Purview labels and DLP reduce accidental exposure. DeviceAre unmanaged devices restricted?AI-assisted work increases the value of stolen sessions or unmanaged access. EvidenceIs audit evidence ready?Security architecture must be provable, not only configured.

Copilot answers from content a user can already access. If SharePoint, Teams or OneDrive permissions are too broad, Copilot can make overshared information easier to discover. Security readiness should therefore include permission cleanup, Purview labels, DLP and audit review.
