documents.t: Microsoft's overview requires Entra ID P1 for Conditional Access; Business Premium also includes access. User/sign-in risk policies require P2, as described in Entra licensing. Agent policies have separate licensing and identity targeting rules. The current agent policy documentation lists Microsoft 365 E7, or Microsoft Agent 365 paired with at least Entra P1 or Microsoft 365 E3, as licensing options. The general overview still marks agent targeting as preview; verify the specific policy's release status in the linked scenario documentation and your tenant rather than declaring all agent controls GA or preview together. A policy targeting an agent identity does not automatically cover delegated user access or an agent user account. Validate the token subject, policy target and report-only results before enforcement.

Microsoft Entra Conditional Access is the policy enforcement engine of Microsoft's Zero Trust architecture. It evaluates user identity, device posture, location, application, risk signals and session context before granting access to corporate resources. This document provides an enterprise design methodology for Microsoft 365, Azure, Security and Copilot deployments.

Conditional Access는 사용자, 접속 기기·위치·앱과 위험 신호를 확인해 접근 조건을 적용하는 Entra ID 기능입니다. 보고 전용 모드와 소수 사용자를 대상으로 먼저 시험하고, 긴급 접근 계정과 예외 대상을 정합니다. 로그인 기록으로 정책 적용 결과를 확인한 뒤 범위를 넓히세요. Copilot은 사용자의 Microsoft 365 자료 접근 권한을 따릅니다. 계정과 기기, 세션과 데이터 보호 정책을 함께 검토하세요.

CredentialCredential theftRequire MFA, sign-in risk controls and strong authentication for risky access. SessionSession hijacking and token replayUse risk signals, session controls and device conditions where appropriate. LegacyLegacy authentication abuseBlock protocols that cannot satisfy modern authentication and MFA requirements. DeviceUnmanaged device accessRequire compliant or managed devices for sensitive workloads and admin access. LocationUnexpected location or networkUse named locations, country rules and trusted network logic carefully. AICopilot data exposure riskAlign Copilot readiness with permission hygiene, device posture and session controls.

01UserUser, group, role, guest status and privileged access context. 02DeviceRegistered, hybrid joined, Entra joined, Intune compliant or unmanaged. 03ContextLocation, application, platform, client app, risk and session state. 04PolicyConditional Access evaluates conditions, exclusions and grant controls. 05ControlRequire MFA, compliant device, app protection, session control or block access. 06AccessAccess is granted, limited, monitored or blocked with audit evidence.

The Require approved client app grant control moved to a read-only state on 2026-06-30. Existing enabled policies can continue to enforce, but administrators cannot create or edit policies using that control. For new policies, use Require app protection policy and verify application support, enrollment model and user impact in report-only mode. See Microsoft's migration guidance. Blocking legacy authentication and disabling a mail protocol are separate decisions. A protocol that uses OAuth is not Basic authentication merely because it is POP, IMAP or SMTP AUTH. Document the protocol requirement and authentication flow before choosing the policy scope.

Layer 1Baseline MFARequire MFA for users, exclude emergency access accounts and validate user impact. Layer 2Admin protectionApply stricter controls to privileged roles, admin portals and management workloads. Layer 3Legacy authentication blockBlock legacy authentication using the relevant client-app conditions. POP, IMAP and SMTP AUTH can also use OAuth; protocol names alone do not identify Basic authentication. Layer 4Device and app controlRequire compliant devices or app protection for sensitive workloads. For new mobile policies, use Require app protection policy rather than the retired approved-client-app control. Layer 5Risk and session controlUse user risk, sign-in risk, Defender device risk, app-enforced restrictions and session controls. Layer 6Workload-specific policiesApply tailored controls for Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Azure and Copilot scenarios.

Lockout PreventionEvery Conditional Access program needs emergency access and exception governance.Security posture improves only if the policy can be operated. Break-glass accounts, exclusions, owner review and expiry dates prevent accidental business outages. Review data permissions and information architecture. RiskRisk-based controlsUse user risk, sign-in risk and device risk signals for sensitive access paths. documents.t: Data Lifecycle Management defines how enterprise information is created, retained, protected, reviewed and disposed across Microsoft 365. For Microsoft 365 and Copilot readiness, lifecycle management reduces data sprawl, improves search quality and helps ensure sensitive or obsolete content is handled according to business and compliance requirements.

documents.s: Unify signals into a security operation executives can trust

documents.t: Microsoft Defender is the security platform that brings together endpoint, identity, email, collaboration, cloud app and XDR capabilities. For enterprise architecture, the goal is not to enable every feature at once. The goal is to build a practical detection, response and prevention model that aligns with identity, device, data and operational ownership.

Consolidate fragmented security tooling Improve incident response across email, endpoint and identity Reduce phishing, malware and lateral movement risk Establish executive security reporting Prepare security posture for Copilot and AI adoption

Defender signal architectureWorkloads to response SignalsMDO, MDE, MDI, MDCAEmail, endpoint, identity and cloud app detections are onboarded with clear ownership. XDRIncident correlationAlerts are grouped into incidents with severity, entity context and recommended actions. OperateSOC triage modelAnalysts follow escalation, containment, evidence and exception handling runbooks. ReportExecutive metricsRisk trend, response time, policy gaps and improvement backlog are reported in business language.

Confirm licensing and security portal access. Enable core workloads in pilot scope. Validate alert flow, incident correlation and RBAC. Tune policies by risk and user group. Establish SOC triage and escalation workflow. Document operational runbooks and exception handling.

Microsoft 365 E5와 E7은 고급 Defender XDR 기능을 포함합니다. E7에는 Entra Suite와 Agent 365도 포함되므로, Defender 보호만 필요한 경우와 AI·에이전트 관리까지 필요한 경우를 나눠 비교하세요. E3는 필요한 엔드포인트·계정·클라우드 앱·메일 보호 기능에 따라 추가 구독을 검토합니다. Microsoft 공식 비교에서 플랜별 포함 범위를 확인하고 사용자 할당과 각 Defender 서비스 설정을 점검하세요.

Separate security reader, analyst, responder and admin roles. Integrate Defender signals with Conditional Access where appropriate. Review alert noise before executive reporting. Validate phishing and endpoint scenarios with controlled tests.

documents.t: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint provides endpoint detection and response, attack surface reduction, vulnerability management and endpoint security telemetry. In enterprise Microsoft 365 programs, it becomes a control input for Defender XDR, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra Conditional Access and security operations. The strongest deployment pattern is to design Defender for Endpoint as an operating model: who owns device onboarding, who approves exceptions, how ASR rules move from audit to block, how incidents are escalated, and how endpoint risk affects access decisions.
Defender for Endpoint로 기기의 위협과 취약점을 확인하고 대응하는 절차를 정리했습니다. Defender XDR, Intune과 Conditional Access를 연결할 때는 기기별 지원 기능과 위험 신호, 정책 적용 결과를 확인하세요.

documents.t: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 protects Microsoft 365 collaboration workloads from phishing, malware, malicious links and unsafe attachments. In enterprise environments, the value comes from designing an email security operating model, not only enabling policies. The practical design question is: which messages are blocked, which are held for review, which users can release, how user-reported phishing is triaged, and how confirmed campaigns become Defender XDR incidents and remediation actions.
Defender for Office 365로 메일과 협업 자료의 피싱, 악성 링크와 첨부파일 위험을 줄이는 방법입니다. Safe Links, Safe Attachments와 피싱 방지 정책을 설정하고, 사용자 신고·격리 검토·오탐 처리와 사고 대응 담당자를 정합니다.

documents.t: Microsoft Defender XDR is Microsoft’s unified pre- and post-breach defense suite. In enterprise consulting, the practical value is not only tool consolidation. The value comes from designing a repeatable operating model where signals are correlated, incidents are assigned, high-confidence actions are automated, and lessons learned are turned into better detection and prevention. This guide explains how to position Defender XDR as the SOC layer for Microsoft 365, Copilot readiness and Zero Trust operations. Defender XDR operating chainDetect, correlate, investigate, respond, improve 01Identity controlConditional Access, risky users, privileged access and sign-in patterns.02Endpoint signalDevice onboarding, EDR evidence, vulnerability context and response action.03Email protectionPhishing, Safe Links, Safe Attachments, campaign view and post-delivery action.04Data exposureSensitive data, DLP signals, insider risk and Copilot data protection context.
Defender XDR로 계정, 기기, 메일과 클라우드 앱의 보안 신호를 연결해 조사하는 방법입니다. SOC 담당자가 경고를 분류하고 원인을 조사한 뒤 격리·복구·보고할 수 있도록 권한과 절차를 정합니다.

Microsoft Defender XDR Reference FlowSecurity signal to executive evidence 01Signal collectionEndpoint, identity, email, cloud app and data signals are licensed, provisioned and healthy. 02Incident correlationRelated alerts are grouped into incidents that show attack scope, impacted assets and evidence. 03Analyst triageSOC roles decide severity, ownership, escalation route and containment priority. 04Response actionAutomated investigation, attack disruption, device isolation, email purge and identity actions are governed. 05Improvement loopHunting queries, detection tuning, KPI review and executive reports improve the security baseline.

EndpointDefender for EndpointEDR, device timeline, vulnerability context, isolation and investigation package. DataPurview SignalsDLP, insider risk and information protection context for data-centric incidents. HuntingAdvanced HuntingKQL-driven investigation across supported Defender and Sentinel tables.

L1 SOCTriageReview new incidents, validate severity, suppress known benign patterns and open escalation tickets. L2 SOCInvestigationUse incident timeline, evidence, affected entities, hunting queries and response history. L3 / DetectionThreat huntingCreate KQL hunts, custom detections, simulation tests and detection tuning backlog. Phishing to identity compromise A realistic incident often starts with a user receiving a malicious message, then continues through endpoint execution, credential exposure, suspicious sign-in and data access attempts. Defender XDR should present this as one attack story instead of several disconnected alerts. 01EmailMalicious URL, attachment, campaign and post-delivery evidence. 02EndpointProcess tree, file activity, device risk and isolation option. 03IdentityRisky sign-in, impossible travel, credential theft or lateral movement signal. 04ResponseDisable account, reset password, purge mail, isolate device and document timeline.

A realistic incident often starts with a user receiving a malicious message, then continues through endpoint execution, credential exposure, suspicious sign-in and data access attempts. Defender XDR should present this as one attack story instead of several disconnected alerts.

Automation is valuable only when the response boundary is clear. Defender XDR programs should define which actions can run automatically, which actions require analyst approval, and which actions require business owner confirmation. Response area Recommended guardrail Device isolation Allow for confirmed high-severity endpoint compromise; require helpdesk notification path. Email purge Use for confirmed malicious campaigns; keep evidence and communication template. User disablement Require severity, business impact and emergency access path review. Attack disruption Review prerequisites, blast radius, exception handling and post-action audit. Custom detection Require owner, test result, false positive review and retirement date.

Advanced hunting should not be treated as a random query library. It should be mapped to the enterprise’s current risk themes. Phase 2Incident workflowDefine severity, owner, escalation, evidence requirements and analyst handover format. Phase 3Response enablementEnable approved automated investigation and response actions with rollback and audit controls. Phase 4Threat huntingBuild query packs for phishing, ransomware, identity compromise, endpoint persistence and data exposure. Phase 5Executive reportingPublish monthly security outcome metrics and improvement backlog tied to business risk.

RiskHigh-risk backlogUnresolved high severity incidents, risky users, exposed devices and remediation SLA.

Deploying Defender workloads without defining incident ownership. Treating every alert as equal instead of using severity, asset criticality and business impact. Enabling automation without rollback, evidence retention or communication templates. Ignoring identity and email signals while focusing only on endpoint telemetry. Reporting only alert count instead of coverage, response speed, risk reduction and repeatable improvements. documents.s: Protect sensitive work without breaking business flow

documents.t: Data Loss Prevention helps organizations prevent sensitive information from being shared through inappropriate channels such as email, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, endpoint copy actions or external collaboration. DLP should be designed as a business control, not only a security rule. The strongest programs combine sensitive information types, user coaching, exception workflow and measurable policy tuning.

Prevent accidental sharing of personal, financial or contractual data Control external sharing from SharePoint and OneDrive Reduce data leakage risk before Copilot adoption Establish evidence for audit and compliance Govern endpoint copy, print and upload behavior

DLP adoption loopAudit before enforcement 01Classify dataMap sensitive information types, trainable classifiers and business-owned data categories. 02Design policySeparate workload scope, conditions, user groups, unmanaged device rules and policy tips. 03Tune impactStart in audit or test mode, review false positives and tune thresholds before enforcement. 04Operate exceptionsUse named reviewers, time-bound exceptions, alert evidence and Copilot data protection reporting.

Define protected data categories with business owners. Select sensitive information types and trainable classifiers where needed. Start with audit or test mode. Review false positives and tune thresholds. Move high-confidence scenarios to warning or block. Define exception request and approval process.

Microsoft는 2026년 10월 Endpoint DLP의 FTP·SFTP 전송 보호를 일반 공급으로 안내했습니다. Purview에 온보딩한 Windows 기기에서 Devices 위치의 정책에 FTP and SFTP transfers 활동을 추가합니다. 소수 사용자를 Audit only로 먼저 운영하고 Activity explorer의 전송 기록을 확인한 뒤 차단 여부를 정하세요. 설정 절차와 권한을 확인합니다. 네트워크 DLP와 Endpoint DLP는 적용 경로가 다릅니다. Entra Global Secure Access 연동에는 Microsoft 365 E7 또는 Purview E5 상당의 사용권과 Entra Internet Access 상당의 사용권 조합이 필요합니다. 다른 SASE·보안 브라우저 연동에는 Purview E5 상당의 사용권과 Purview 종량제 설정이 필요하며, B2B 게스트는 네트워크 보호 정책 대상에서 제외됩니다. 연동별 라이선스와 제한을 확인하고 실제 전송 경로를 시험하세요.

Teams의 공유 채널과 외부 액세스 채팅은 DLP 적용 방식이 다릅니다. 공유 채널에서는 각 발신자의 소속 테넌트 정책으로 메시지를 평가합니다. 외부 액세스 채팅에서는 대화를 시작한 테넌트가 호스트이며, 그 호스트에 소속된 사용자의 메시지에 호스트 정책을 적용합니다. 다른 테넌트 사용자의 메시지까지 호스트 정책으로 검사하거나, 사용자 소속 테넌트의 정책이 외부 호스트 대화에도 자동으로 따라간다고 가정하지 마세요. 시험할 때는 채팅을 시작하는 조직을 바꾸고 양쪽 사용자가 보낸 메시지의 처리 결과를 확인하세요. 공유 파일은 저장된 SharePoint·OneDrive 위치에 적용되는 정책도 따로 점검합니다. Teams 대화별 DLP 적용 범위를 참고하세요.
Advanced DLP across Microsoft 365 workloads and endpoints may require higher compliance licensing. Confirm workload coverage before committing policy scope in a proposal.

Use separate policies for high-risk and medium-risk data. Apply stricter controls to unmanaged devices and external recipients. Route alerts to a named review owner. Keep policy exceptions time-bound and auditable.

Enforcement mode Which scenarios start in audit, warn or block mode? Exception model Who approves temporary exceptions and how are they reviewed? User coaching What policy tip explains the business reason to users? Alert review Who reviews DLP alerts and tunes false positives?

Usually no. Start with audit or test mode for priority scenarios, review false positives and user impact, then move high-confidence rules to warn or block.

Microsoft Purview Information Barriers (IB) is used to restrict communication and collaboration between users or groups when the organization has conflict-of-interest, segregation-of-duty, internal control or regulated collaboration requirements. IB should not be treated as a simple user blocking feature. It should be designed as a control model that connects collaboration restriction matrix, segments, policies, workload validation, exception management and audit evidence. Executive lens: Information Barriers are not just a Teams chat restriction. They are a segmentation model across users, groups, sites and collaboration workloads that must be validated with both allowed and blocked communication evidence. documents.t: Purview의 데이터 분류·보호·보존·감사 기능을 정리한 문서입니다. 보안·법무·IT 담당자와 자료 소유자가 보호할 정보와 보관·공유 기준을 합의합니다. 기능별 라이선스와 적용되는 앱은 따로 확인하세요.

Typical drivers for a Purview program: Classify and protect sensitive documents with a usable label taxonomy. Reduce accidental leakage through DLP across Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, endpoint and cloud apps. Prepare Microsoft 365 data for Copilot and agent adoption. Support audit, retention, eDiscovery, insider risk and communication compliance. Establish exception approval and policy review cadence across departments. For enterprise group governance programs, the value of Purview is often the common language it creates between legal, security, IT and business owners. Policy design becomes stronger when business owners can understand the categories, exceptions and expected user behavior.

Purview Operating ModelFrom data inventory to AI-ready protection 01Data InventoryIdentify sensitive repositories, data owners and priority business processes. 02ClassificationDefine sensitivity labels, business categories and publishing scope. 03ProtectionApply encryption, DLP, endpoint control and external sharing rules. 04EvidenceConfigure audit, retention, eDiscovery and exception register. 05AI ReadinessReview oversharing, Copilot data exposure and sensitive content access. 06OperateTune policies using alerts, false positives, user feedback and review cadence.

Business-readableSmall taxonomy firstStart with a few labels that employees can understand. Too many labels reduce adoption and increase misclassification. Policy-backedPublishing scopeDecide which users receive which labels, whether defaults apply and which workloads are in scope. Protection-readyEncryption and markingUse encryption, content marking and access restrictions only where business impact is clear. AI-readyCopilot boundaryLabels should help security and business owners reason about sensitive content exposure in Copilot and search.

DLP should not begin with aggressive blocking. A stronger delivery pattern is: Define priority sensitive information types and scenarios. Run DLP in test mode and collect evidence. Tune false positives with business owners. Move from audit to warning and then to block only where justified. Record exception approvals, expiry and review owners. DetectFind sensitive activityUse DLP matches, endpoint signals and sharing activity to understand risk before enforcement. TuneReduce false positivesAdjust thresholds, conditions and exclusions with evidence from pilot users. EnforceApply the right controlChoose audit, notify, justify, block or override based on business impact. ReviewOperate as a programTrack alerts, exceptions, repeat offenders, policy drift and adoption feedback.

Purview programs should prepare evidence before a legal or executive request arrives. The baseline should include: Retention decisions tied to business, legal and regulatory requirements. Audit configuration and access review for privileged compliance roles. eDiscovery readiness, custodian workflow and case handover process. Communication Compliance and Insider Risk scope where the organization has clear policy basis. Evidence register showing why each policy exists and who approved it.

Copilot readiness should combine Purview with access hygiene: Readiness Area What To Validate Sensitivity labels Are sensitive repositories labeled or discoverable through data classification? Permissions Are SharePoint sites, Teams and OneDrive links over-shared? DLP Are priority leakage paths monitored before broad Copilot rollout? Audit Can security teams explain who accessed sensitive content and when? Data owner Does each sensitive repository have an accountable owner? Exception handling Are business exceptions approved, time-bound and reviewable?

An anonymized enterprise group governance program used Purview not as a single technical deployment, but as a cross-functional operating model. Security, legal, IT and business owners agreed on a small label taxonomy, tested DLP before enforcement, documented exception handling and aligned Copilot readiness with oversharing review. The result was a governance model that could be explained to executives and operated by the security team after handover.

Evidence Purpose Label taxonomy Show business-readable classification structure Label policy scope Prove who receives which labels and why DLP test results Validate policy effect before enforcement Exception register Document approvals, reasons, owner and expiry Oversharing review Identify sensitive repositories before Copilot expansion Review cadence Define how policies are tuned and approved over time Handover guide Make operations repeatable after project closure

Starting with too many labels instead of a simple taxonomy users understand. Blocking DLP from day one without false-positive evidence. Treating Copilot readiness as a license or model question instead of a data exposure question. Leaving exception approval informal and unaudited. Letting IT define sensitive data categories without business and legal owners.

Zero Trust is not a single product implementation. It is an enterprise security architecture based on continuous verification, least privilege access, device trust, data protection and security monitoring. For Microsoft cloud environments, Zero Trust should be designed across Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Intune, Defender, Purview and Microsoft 365 workloads. Zero Trust Reference Architecture Verify access, protect data and operate response continuously Zero Trust becomes practical when identity, device trust, Conditional Access, Defender, Purview, Microsoft 365 workloads and operations evidence are designed together. VerifyLimitProtectRespond Security Control PlaneIdentity to operations evidence 01IdentityEnforce MFA, Conditional Access, privileged access and guest lifecycle controls.02DeviceUse Intune compliance, security baseline and Defender for Endpoint signals.03DataClassify, label, retain and protect information with Microsoft Purview.04OperateCorrelate incidents, tune alerts, define response process and review evidence. Zero Trust ruleDo not treat Zero Trust as a product rollout. Treat it as a phased control and evidence operating model.

A license estimate is a dated planning model, not a quote or a statement of contractual entitlement. Validate the final recommendation against the current Microsoft Product Terms, service descriptions, licensing guides and the customer's purchasing agreement. Step Estimation method Inputs Segment users by persona, workload and device pattern; capture security and compliance requirements, current subscriptions and service plans, eligible base licenses, Copilot scenarios, monthly usage assumptions, environments, connectors and third-party dependencies. Assumptions Record the effective date, geography and cloud, purchasing channel and term, feature availability, user growth, peak usage, and which preview capabilities are excluded. Entitlement layers Separate the base user or device subscription from add-ons that require an eligible prerequisite. Keep consumption or capacity charges, Azure usage and third-party services in separate lines. Duplicate check Map each required capability to current service-plan entitlements before adding a license. Mark included, standalone, add-on, unused and gap states so overlapping suite rights aren't counted twice. Pilot to production Use pilot telemetry to replace usage assumptions. Recalculate production for the full eligible population, peak and growth, environment separation, connectors, monitoring, support, resilience and overage handling; don't extrapolate by seat count alone. Report the result by persona with the recommended base, add-ons, consumption range, retained entitlements, gaps, alternatives, assumptions, source date and confidence. Keep list prices out of the method and obtain a current commercial quote before purchase. Official sources: Microsoft Product Terms, Microsoft 365 service descriptions, Microsoft 365 Copilot license options, Copilot Studio billing rates and management, and Copilot Studio credits and capacity.

사용자 유형별로 업무, 기기, 보안·규정 준수 요구와 Copilot 사용 계획을 정리합니다. 현재 구독과 서비스 플랜을 필요한 기능에 맞춰 비교하고, 추가 기능에 필요한 기본 라이선스와 외부 서비스·커넥터도 기록하세요. 포함된 기능, 별도 구매할 기능, 쓰지 않는 기능과 부족한 기능을 구분해 같은 사용 권리를 두 번 계산하지 않습니다. 산정표에는 확인 날짜, 이용 지역과 클라우드, 구매 경로와 계약 기간을 적습니다. 기능의 제공 상태, 사용자 증가율과 월간·최대 사용량을 가정하고, 도입 대상에서 제외한 미리 보기 기능도 표시하세요. 구매 권리와 가격은 실제 계약 조건과 최신 견적서로 확인합니다. 비용은 사용자·기기의 기본 구독, 추가 기능, 사용량·용량, Azure와 타사 서비스로 나눠 계산합니다. 시범 도입에서 실제 사용 기록을 모아 예상값을 고치고, 운영 전환 전에는 환경 분리, 커넥터, 모니터링, 지원, 장애 대비와 초과 사용 비용을 다시 계산하세요. 사용자 수에 비례해 비용이 늘어난다고 가정하지 않습니다. 결과에는 사용자 유형별 기본 구독과 추가 기능, 예상 사용량, 유지할 구독, 부족한 기능과 대안을 정리합니다. 계산에 쓴 가정과 출처의 확인 날짜, 근거가 얼마나 확실한지도 함께 남기세요. 가격은 고정된 정가표 대신 구매 시점의 견적을 적용합니다.

This library contains reusable enterprise prompts designed for Microsoft consulting, architecture design, proposal development, security assessment and Copilot transformation engagements. Prompts are intended to accelerate consulting delivery while maintaining consistent quality standards. Use these prompts as structured starting points, not as final customer deliverables. A consultant should always add customer context, industry constraints, current-state findings, risk decisions and implementation assumptions before sharing the output externally. For Microsoft terminology, keep product names such as Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Purview and Copilot in English, while writing the surrounding explanation in natural Korean or concise business English depending on the audience.
